sources.title: bytkim/Qwen3.6-27B-MTP-pi-tune-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-27B is a causal language model with a vision encoder. Image and video understanding are supported by pairing the language-model GGUF with the compatible Qwen3.6 mmproj-F16.gguf sidecar (see §4 Multi-modal inference).
